configuration_constraints: HUBUUM_TASK_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS must be less than HUBUUM_TASK_LEASE_SECONDS
HUBUUM_RUNTIME_ROLE=worker requires at least one task, fan-out, delivery, event-retention, or token-retention worker
HUBUUM_TLS_CERT_PATH and HUBUUM_TLS_KEY_PATH must be configured together
HUBUUM_PERMISSION_BACKEND=treetop requires HUBUUM_TREETOP_URL and the compiled permissions-treetop feature
HUBUUM_LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND=valkey requires HUBUUM_LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_VALKEY_URL and the compiled valkey feature
HUBUUM_REQUIRE_STABLE_TOKEN_HASH_KEY=true requires resolvable stable token hash key material

schema_version_semantics: omitted builder value defaults to the current event schema version
incompatible envelope, provenance, or sink payload shape changes require an increase
redaction_rules: partially visible events replace before and after with null
partially visible events replace metadata with an empty object
event debug output never includes before, after, metadata, or routing secrets

backup.rejection_policy: reject any backup_version other than the current version

import.rejection_policy: reject any import version other than the current version

compatibility_policy.additive: new optional fields, commands, variables, metrics, or catalog values
compatibility_policy.behavioral: changed defaults, descriptions, scopes, or expanded bounded value domains
compatibility_policy.breaking: removed or narrowed items, changed types, labels, buckets, requirements, or unversioned format shapes
